subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen upstream GitHub Action revisions at workflows that mint app tokens, publish releases/images, attest artifacts, and invoke secret-backed agents?
rationale: This is an intentional trust-boundary decision about newly executed third-party Action code; a mechanical patch review cannot decide repository supply-chain acceptance.

options.title: Review and accept the pins
options.body: Verify the upstream release/commit changes for the privileged call sites, then merge only after the rebased head and required checks are satisfactory.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Land lower-risk workflow action bumps separately and hold token, publishing, attestation, and secret-backed agent action revisions for focused security review.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or defer the Dependabot batch if the repository does not want to advance these executable Action dependencies together.

recommendation.title: Review and accept the pins
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream release/commit changes for the privileged call sites, then merge only after the rebased head and required checks are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns acceptance of executable workflow dependencies at privileged repository boundaries.
